import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    # Find first occurrence of "at" starting from index 1 (skip first character)
    at_pos = s.find("at", 1)
    # Replace that "at" with '@'
    s2 = s[:at_pos] + '@' + s[at_pos+2:]
    
    result_parts = []
    last = 0
    i = s2.find("dot", 1)  # start from index 1
    while i != -1 and i < len(s2) - 3:
        result_parts.append(s2[last:i])
        result_parts.append('.')
        last = i + 3
        i = s2.find("dot", last)
    result_parts.append(s2[last:])
    print(''.join(result_parts))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
